Dear Hiring Team,

I am writing to apply for the Junior Performance Marketer position at Distrilink. As a junior digital marketer with a strong analytical foundation and hands-on experience in SEO, content, and web analytics, I am excited about the opportunity to contribute to your marketplace advertising efforts.

In my current role at Episto, I manage on-page SEO, keyword research, and performance tracking using tools like Google Analytics, Search Console, and SEMrush. I have also built and optimized WordPress sites, implementing structured data and technical audits to improve visibility. My project mirook.com demonstrates my ability to apply data-driven strategies to enhance search performance.

I am comfortable with numbers, Excel, and dashboards, and I am eager to learn marketplace advertising platforms like Amazon and Bol.com. My fluency in English and Turkish, along with my ongoing Dutch studies (B1), align with your language requirements.

I am precise, structured, and quick to adapt to new tools, making me a strong fit for your fast-growing team. I would welcome the chance to discuss how my skills can support Distrilink's growth.

Thank you for considering my application.

Best regards,
Baver Ok

cover_letter:
Dear Hiring Team,

I am excited to apply for the Junior Performance Marketer position at Distrilink. As a junior digital marketer with a strong analytical mindset and hands-on experience in SEO, content, and web analytics, I am drawn to your mission of helping consumer brands scale across European marketplaces. Your use of the Pulse AI platform and data-driven approach resonates with my own focus on measurable results.

In my current role at Episto, I manage on-page SEO for client websites, conduct keyword research, and write targeted content to improve organic visibility. I track performance using tools like Google Analytics, Search Console, SEMrush, and Ahrefs, and I am comfortable with data analysis and reporting. My technical background in web development (WordPress, Elementor) and my project mirook.com, where I implemented structured data and technical SEO/GEO audits, have honed my ability to optimize digital assets for both traditional and AI-powered search engines.

While my experience is primarily in SEO, I am eager to apply my analytical skills to performance marketing. I am quick to learn new platforms and have a strong foundation in numbers and dashboards. I am fluent in English and Turkish, with Dutch at B1 and improving. I am precise, structured, and thrive in fast-paced environments, as demonstrated by my logistics experience at Katoen Natie.

I am particularly excited about the opportunity to work with marketplaces like Amazon and Bol.com, and to contribute to campaign management, keyword research, and reporting. I am confident that my skills and enthusiasm make me a strong candidate for this role.

Thank you for considering my application. I look forward to the possibility of contributing to Distrilink's growth.

Sincerely,
Baver Ok

Baver Ok
Digital Marketing · SEO · GEO · Content · Web
Zwijndrecht, Belgium | +32 470 42 48 36 | baverok@gmail.com | linkedin.com/in/baverok

## Profile
Junior digital marketer with a strong analytical foundation and hands-on experience in SEO, content, and web analytics. At Episto, I manage on-page SEO, keyword research, and performance tracking for client websites, using tools like Google Analytics, Search Console, SEMrush, and Ahrefs. On my own project (mirook.com), I applied structured data, entity optimization, and technical SEO/GEO audits to improve visibility across both traditional and AI-powered search engines. Comfortable with data analysis, dashboards, and Excel, and eager to apply my skills to performance marketing and marketplace advertising. Based in Zwijndrecht, next to Antwerp. Works in English and Turkish; Dutch: B1, currently taking classes to improve further.

## Core Skills
- Analytics & Reporting: Google Analytics, Google Search Console, SEMrush, Ahrefs, Google Ads, Excel, dashboards
- SEO & GEO: on-page SEO, keyword research, technical SEO audits, structured data / JSON-LD schema, entity optimization, GEO & AEO (AI search visibility)
- Content & CMS: SEO blog & content writing, editorial content publishing, website content management, WordPress site building
- Web & Build: WordPress, Elementor, Astra theme, responsive web design, Canva, AI-assisted content tools
- Social: social media content & integration
- Languages: English (professional), Turkish (native), Dutch (B1)

- Own on-page SEO for client websites, from keyword research to publishing, improving organic visibility and search rankings
- Write keyword-targeted blog content for client websites to grow organic traffic
- Build and maintain client websites in WordPress using Elementor and the Astra theme, including content uploads and page updates
- Track site performance with SEMrush, Ahrefs, Google Analytics, Google Search Console, and Google Ads to guide SEO and content decisions

### Warehouse & Logistics — Katoen Natie (Antwerp), 2025–2026
- Maintained accuracy and efficiency in a high-volume, fast-paced logistics environment

### Front-End Developer — ViviDoctor (Belgium), 2018–2019
- Developed and optimized front-end features for a healthcare web application (AngularJS, JavaScript)

## Projects

### mirook.com — Website Design, SEO & GEO (2025–present)
- Designed and built a multi-page WordPress site (Elementor, Astra) for a Belgian youth chess champion: full site structure, on-page SEO, and social media integration (Instagram/Facebook)
- Implemented structured data (JSON-LD schema, including SportsEvent and FAQPage), entity/knowledge-graph markup, and an llms.txt file to improve visibility across traditional and AI-powered search engines (GEO/AEO)
- Ran iterative technical SEO/GEO audits, measurably raising the site's overall search-health score
